glosses.notes: Can mean subsidizing a cost, or the money given to help cover that cost.

examples.sentence: 这家店刚开的时候一直靠政府补贴房租，后来客人慢慢多了，老板才敢把早晚两班的人手重新加回来。
为了让住得远的学生也能安心实习，学校给每天来回时间太长的人发交通补贴，月底再按记录统一结算。
新开的社区食堂虽然收费不高，可是前几个月还是要靠公司一起补贴，不然很难把热饭热菜一直卖得这么便宜。

example_translations.translation: When this shop first opened, it relied on government subsidies to cover the rent. Only after customers gradually became more numerous did the owner dare to add staff back to the morning and evening shifts.

So that students living far away could do their internships with peace of mind, the school gave transportation subsidies to those whose daily round-trip took too long, then settled the amount together at the end of the month according to the records.

Although the new community canteen did not charge much, it still had to be subsidized by the company during the first few months; otherwise it would have been hard to keep selling hot meals that cheaply.

glosses.notes: Means taking extra lessons to catch up, review, or strengthen a subject outside regular class.

examples.sentence: 孩子最近总听不懂老师上课说的话，母亲没有马上生气，而是先陪他把前面几课再看一遍，再安排他周末去补习。
他白天在店里帮忙，晚上还得赶去补习英语，所以常常回到家已经很晚，只能一边吃面一边看笔记。
老师发现几个学生准备考试的方法不对，就建议他们别只靠临时熬夜，最好早点补习前面没有弄懂的部分。

example_translations.translation: The child had recently been unable to follow what the teacher was saying in class, so his mother did not get angry right away. Instead, she first went back over the previous lessons with him and then arranged extra lessons for the weekend.
He helps at the shop during the day and still has to rush off for English tutoring at night, so he often gets home very late and can only eat noodles while looking over his notes.

The teacher noticed that several students were preparing for the exam the wrong way, so she suggested they stop relying only on last-minute late nights and start getting help with the parts they had not understood earlier.

glosses.notes: Means cloth or fabric as a material, often for clothing, covers, or other sewn items.

examples.sentence: 她把那块布放在桌子上看了很久，后来才决定要不要把它做成孩子上学时背的小包。
奶奶舍不得扔那块旧布，说那还是年轻时候买回来的，改一改还能给孩子做个小包。
下雨那天，门口卖菜的人临时拿一块布盖住车上的菜，怕路上的灰又落到上面。

example_translations.translation: She studied that piece of cloth on the table for a long time before deciding whether to make it into the little bag the child would carry to school.
Grandma could not bear to throw away that old piece of fabric, saying she had bought it when she was young and that with a few changes it could still become a little bag for the child.
On the rainy day, the vegetable seller at the entrance used a piece of cloth to cover the vegetables on the cart, worried that dust from the road would settle on them again.

glosses.notes: Describes feeling uneasy, unsettled, or anxious because something does not feel secure yet.

examples.sentence: 医生说检查结果明天才出来以后，全家虽然嘴上都说没事，可是谁也看得出母亲心里一直不安。
她刚到新的办公室时总有点不安，连同事只是过来问一句要不要帮忙，她都会先站起来解释半天。
听见楼下半夜一直有人敲门，住在隔壁的老人越来越不安，只好先给儿子打电话，请他回来看看。

example_translations.translation: After the doctor said the test results would not be ready until tomorrow, the whole family kept saying it was fine, but everyone could see that the mother still felt uneasy inside.

When she first arrived at the new office, she always felt a little unsettled. Even if a coworker only came over to ask whether she needed help, she would stand up first and explain herself for a long time.

Hearing someone keep knocking downstairs in the middle of the night, the elderly neighbor next door grew more and more anxious and finally called her son first, asking him to come back and take a look.

glosses.notes: A written or formal adverb meaning someone never did something up to that point.

examples.sentence: 他虽然来这里很多年了，但是说到最早住过的房间时，还是会说自己不曾忘记那段日子。
老师平时看上去很严，但是学生后来才知道，他从来不曾因为谁家里有问题就少给一次说明。
奶奶年轻时条件不好，不曾坐过火车，所以这次跟我们去外地的时候，一上车就一直望着窗外笑。

example_translations.translation: Although he has lived here for many years, whenever the conversation turns to the room he first stayed in, he still says he has never forgotten those days.
The teacher usually seemed strict, but the students later learned that he had never once given less explanation just because someone had problems at home.
When Grandma was young, conditions were poor and she had never ridden a train, so on this trip out of town with us, she smiled at the view outside the window the whole time as soon as she got on.

glosses.notes: Can reject an idea as unacceptable, and it also appears in rhetorical questions meaning that perhaps something is the case.

examples.sentence: 你今天下午还没有把材料送来，这样不成，还是得明天一早就送到办公室。
窗户坏成这样不成，还是得马上找人来修，不然晚上谁也睡不好。
大家已经商量了这么久，不成到了最后又要因为一点小事全部从头来过吧？

example_translations.translation: You still have not brought the materials this afternoon, and that will not do, so they will have to be delivered to the office first thing tomorrow morning.
With the window broken like this, it just will not do. Someone has to be found to fix it right away, otherwise nobody will sleep well tonight.
We have already discussed this for so long; could it really be that at the very end we still have to start all over again because of one small issue?

glosses.notes: A formal written word used in rules and notices for must not, and in 不得不 for have to.

examples.sentence: 进去以后不得大声说话，也不得在车上吃东西，所以大家一上车就先把包放好。
合同里写着住户不得随便改动家里的东西，要是真想改，得先跟工作人员把时间和办法说清楚。
他为了赶在截止前把表交上，晚上不得不留在办公室把最后几页重新整理一遍，连晚饭都错过了。

example_translations.translation: After going in, people must not speak loudly or eat on the vehicle, so everyone puts their bags away properly as soon as they board.
The contract says that residents must not casually change things in the home. If they really want to make changes, they have to explain the timing and plan clearly to the staff first.
In order to hand in the form before the deadline, he had no choice but to stay in the office that evening and reorganize the last few pages, even missing dinner.

glosses.notes: Means troops or a military unit, usually referring to an organized group rather than one single soldier.

examples.sentence: 父亲年轻时在西北的部队待过很多年，所以现在一听见别人喊集合，走路还是会一下子快起来。
那支部队每天很早就起来，所以后来大家做事都不敢太慢。
那支部队走过很多地方，所以老师一边给大家看照片，一边慢慢讲它后面的故事。

example_translations.translation: My father spent many years in a military unit in the northwest when he was young, so even now, as soon as he hears someone call for everyone to assemble, his pace suddenly quickens.
That unit got up very early every day, so afterward everyone did not dare to move too slowly when working.
That troop unit had traveled through many places, so the teacher showed everyone the photos and slowly told the story behind them.

glosses.notes: Means being unable to hold something back, such as a laugh, tears, or some other reaction.

examples.sentence: 听见台上的老人慢慢唱起年轻时最爱听的那首歌，坐在后排的几个人都不禁跟着轻轻唱了几句。
孩子刚学会骑车那天，手都是汗，可是一到终点还是不禁大声笑了出来。
看见母亲几十年前写的信整整齐齐放在那里，她不禁停下手里的活，坐在床边一封一封读起来。

example_translations.translation: Hearing the old man on stage slowly begin the song he had loved most in his youth, several people in the back row could not help softly singing a few lines along with him.
On the day the child first learned to ride a bicycle, his hands were covered in sweat, but the moment he reached the finish he still could not help laughing out loud.
Seeing the letters her mother had written decades earlier laid out there in neat order, she could not help stopping her work, sitting by the bed, and reading them one by one.

glosses.notes: Means something happens repeatedly at intervals rather than just once.

examples.sentence: 这家小店地方不大，老板一边给客人煮面，一边还不时抬头看看门外，怕送货的人又把东西放错地方。
火车晚点那一晚，广播不时提醒大家先别挤到前面，因为大家还在一个一个看新的上车时间。
老人住院以后，女儿白天在公司开会，不时也会低头看手机，怕医生临时打来电话找不到她。

example_translations.translation: The shop is not large, so while the owner boils noodles for customers, he still lifts his head from time to time to look outside, worried that the delivery person has once again put something in the wrong place.
On the night the train was delayed, the broadcast kept reminding everyone every now and then not to crowd toward the front because people were still checking the new boarding time one by one.

After the elderly man was admitted to the hospital, his daughter spent the day in company meetings, but she still glanced down at her phone at intervals in case the doctor called and could not reach her.

glosses.notes: Means a specific part or location, especially on the body or within an object.

examples.sentence: 医生按了按他受伤的部位，又问他刚才是先碰到脚还是腰，好判断后面还要不要再检查。
这件外套最容易坏的部位不是下面那一块，而是包总压着的肩膀那里，所以工作人员特别提醒他别装太重。
老师给大家讲人体结构时，没有一开始就背名字，而是先拿图片指出几个最重要的部位，让学生自己跟着找。

example_translations.translation: The doctor pressed the injured part and then asked whether he had hit his foot or his waist first just now, so the doctor could judge whether further checks were still needed.

The part of this coat that wears out most easily is not the piece lower down, but the shoulder area where the bag keeps pressing, so the staff member especially reminded him not to pack it too heavily.

When the teacher explained human anatomy, she did not start by making everyone memorize names. Instead, she first used a picture to point out several of the most important parts and let the students find them on their own.

glosses.notes: A direct spoken or written way to say someone is not allowed to do something.

examples.sentence: 父亲刚把客厅收拾干净，就对几个孩子说，今天谁都不许把球带进来，不然晚上自己擦地。
工作人员反复提醒新来的学生，楼道里不许堆东西，也不许在门口放太多鞋，不然大家上楼下楼都不方便。
她本来想替同事把错误改掉，经理看见以后马上拦住她，说不许这样，下次必须让对方自己重写。

example_translations.translation: Right after the father finished cleaning the living room, he told the children that no one was allowed to bring a ball in today, otherwise they could mop the floor themselves that evening.

The staff kept reminding the new students that they were not allowed to pile things in the hallway or leave too many shoes by the door, otherwise it would be inconvenient for everyone going up and down.
She had wanted to fix her coworker's mistake for him, but the manager stopped her at once and said that was not allowed and the other person had to rewrite it himself next time.

glosses.notes: Means something is not suitable or not advisable under the circumstances.

examples.sentence: 医生看完体检单以后提醒他，这段时间胃还没有恢复，不宜吃太辣的东西，也不宜一忙就不睡觉。
山里天气变得太快，导游出发前先告诉大家，下午那条路现在不宜单独走，最好跟着大家一起上去。
这种话在大家都着急的时候当面说并不宜，所以她先把最重要的情况记下来，打算会后再单独解释。

example_translations.translation: After looking over the physical exam report, the doctor reminded him that his stomach had not recovered yet, so it was not advisable to eat overly spicy food or to stay up whenever work became busy.

Because the weather in the mountains changes too quickly, the guide told everyone before departure that the path for the afternoon was not suitable for walking alone and that it was best to go up together with the group.

It would not be wise to say that kind of thing face to face while everyone was already anxious, so she first wrote down the most important facts and planned to explain them privately after the meeting.

glosses.notes: Usually follows a feeling or action to mean it keeps going without stopping.

examples.sentence: 听说老朋友从外地赶回来帮忙，母亲感动不已，连手里的活都没有放下，就站在门口一直说谢谢。
小队终于在天黑前把孩子找到了，孩子的父亲激动不已，一边抱着孩子不放，一边一直说谢谢。
看到自己小时候写的信居然被老师一直留到现在，她惊讶不已，坐下以后好半天都不知道先说什么。

example_translations.translation: When she heard that an old friend had rushed back from another city to help, Mother was deeply moved and stood at the door saying thank you again and again without even putting down the work in her hands.
The team finally found the child before dark, and the child's father was overjoyed, holding the child tightly and saying thank you over and over.
Seeing that the letters she had written as a child had actually been kept by her teacher until now, she was astonished beyond words and sat there for a long while without knowing what to say first.

glosses.notes: Can mean arranging a space or setting things out, and it also commonly means assigning work or homework.

examples.sentence: 节目前一天，大家一直忙到很晚才把会场布置好，连门口那排最容易被忽略的小灯也重新擦了一遍。
班主任知道大家周末都有安排，所以这次只布置了一项调查作业，让每个人回家先问问长辈年轻时最想做什么。
房子不大，但是她把桌子和书架重新布置以后，靠着窗户的地方一下子就很适合看书。

example_translations.translation: The day before the program, everyone worked until very late before the venue was fully arranged, and even the small lights by the entrance that were easiest to overlook were wiped down again.

The homeroom teacher knew everyone already had plans for the weekend, so this time she assigned only one survey task and asked each person to go home and first ask an elder what they had most wanted to do when they were young.
The room was not large, but after she rearranged the desk and the bookshelf, the place by the window suddenly became very suitable for reading.

glosses.notes: Commonly means more than or not only, often introducing something beyond the first point mentioned.

examples.sentence: 为了这次活动，他们不止去了一个城市找资料，连几个已经关门的小店也慢慢打听到了。
这件事麻烦的不止是时间太紧，还因为几个部门说法不一样，所以谁都不敢先把最后的话说死。
他来这里不止因为味道好，更因为老板记得每个老客人吃什么，一见面就先把热茶端上来。

example_translations.translation: For this event, they did more than go to one city to look for materials; they even slowly tracked down several little shops that had already closed.
The trouble with this matter is not only that the time is too tight. It is also that several departments describe it differently, so nobody dares to make the final wording too firm first.
He comes here not only because the food tastes good, but even more because the owner remembers what each regular customer eats and brings over hot tea the moment they meet.

glosses.notes: Means a step in a process or procedure, especially when something must be done in order.

examples.sentence: 机器刚送到的时候，师傅先把每一个步骤都做给大家看一遍，又让我们按顺序写下来，怕回去以后记混。
老师把实验的几个步骤先写在纸上，就是怕第一次做的人一紧张，就把前后顺序记混了。
她做这道点心从来不肯省步骤，因为少一次发面或者少等几分钟，最后出来的口感就完全不一样。

example_translations.translation: When the machine had just been delivered, the technician first demonstrated every step for everyone once, then had us write them down in order so we would not mix them up after going back.
The teacher wrote the steps of the experiment down on paper first because she was afraid that people doing it for the first time would get the order mixed up as soon as they got nervous.
She never cuts steps when making this pastry, because if one round of dough rising is skipped or even a few minutes of waiting are lost, the final texture comes out completely different.

glosses.notes: Means guessing or speculating when the facts are not yet clear.

examples.sentence: 会议还没开始，大家已经在门口小声猜测新来的经理会先调整哪一部分工作，连平时最安静的人都忍不住开口。
看到他把旧照片一张一张放在桌子上，家里人都在猜测他是不是要把这些年写的回忆整理出来。
医生说检查还没有做完，最好别只凭网上看到的内容乱猜测，不然人还没拿到结果，心里先乱了。

example_translations.translation: Before the meeting had even started, everyone at the door was already quietly speculating about which part of the work the new manager would adjust first, and even the person who was usually the quietest could not help speaking up.
Seeing him place the old photos on the table one by one, the family all began guessing whether he was going to organize the memories he had written over the years.

The doctor said the examination was not finished yet, so it was best not to keep guessing wildly based only on things seen online; otherwise the patient would become unsettled before even getting the results.

glosses.notes: Means property or assets that belong to a person, family, or organization.

examples.sentence: 火灾过后，最让他们发愁的不是把家里再整理一遍，而是要慢慢看哪些财产还能用，哪些已经没法再用了。
老人搬去和儿子一起住之前，先把家里的财产和证件一项一项写清楚，省得以后兄弟姐妹之间再起误会。
法院的人来登记时，一再提醒双方把共同财产说完整，不要等材料交上去以后又临时想起还有别的东西。

example_translations.translation: After the fire, what worried them most was not putting the home back in order again, but slowly checking which property could still be used and which things were already beyond repair.
Before the elderly man moved in with his son, he first wrote down the family's property and documents item by item so that misunderstandings would not arise later among the brothers and sisters.

When the court staff came to register the case, they repeatedly reminded both sides to give a full account of the shared property instead of suddenly remembering other items only after the papers had been submitted.

glosses.notes: Means wealth in money or valuables, and by extension something valuable people can build or pass on.

examples.sentence: 这些年认识的人、走过的地方和学会的本事，对他来说也都是财富。
这座小城过去留下来的老房子和老戏台，在很多人眼里不只是旅游资源，更是大家共同的文化财富。
他没有太多钱，但是这些年认识的人、走过的地方和学会的本事，对他来说也都是财富。

example_translations.translation: The people he has met over the years, the places he has gone, and the abilities he has learned are all forms of wealth to him.
The old houses and old opera stage left behind in this small city are seen by many people not only as tourism resources, but even more as a shared cultural treasure.
He does not have much money, but the people he has met over the years, the places he has gone, and the abilities he has learned are all forms of wealth to him.

glosses.notes: Means notable talent or creative brilliance that shows in what someone can do.

examples.sentence: 老师知道这个学生很有才华，所以每次批改作文都很认真。
老师知道这个学生有写作才华，所以每次批改作文时都不只改错，还会认真告诉他哪一句最有力量。
那个年轻人的才华原来一直没有让大家看见，直到那次活动以后，公司才开始把重要工作交给他。

example_translations.translation: The teacher knew this student was very talented, so each time she corrected his composition, she did it with great care.
The teacher knew this student had writing talent, so every time she corrected his composition, she did not only mark mistakes but also seriously told him which sentence carried the most force.
That young person's talent had gone unseen for a long time, and only after that event did the company begin handing important work to him.

glosses.notes: Means ability or talent, pointing to the real capacity a person has to do something well.

examples.sentence: 经理安排新项目的时候，不是只看谁最会说话，而是先看每个人真正的才能放在哪个位置上最合适。
他的才能很早就看出来了，但是父母没有急着让他去比赛。
经理知道他有才能，所以后来重要工作都先让他来做。

example_translations.translation: When the manager assigns a new project, he does not only look at who speaks the best; he first considers where each person's real abilities fit best.
His talent was recognized very early, but his parents did not rush to send him into competitions.
The manager knew he had ability, so later the important work was always handed to him first.

glosses.notes: Means finance or financial affairs, especially money management inside a company or organization.

examples.sentence: 公司最近换了新的财务系统，几个老同事一下子都不太习惯，只好先把报表和发票重新对了一遍。
她原来在门店管进货，后来因为做事细，又肯把每一笔钱说清楚，就被调去财务部门帮忙。
会议上谈到财务压力的时候，经理没有只说数字，而是把接下来三个月最可能出现的问题一条一条摆给大家看。

example_translations.translation: The company recently switched to a new finance system, and several longtime coworkers were not used to it at all, so they had to go back through the reports and invoices one more time.

She had originally handled purchasing at the branch store, but because she worked carefully and was willing to explain every sum of money clearly, she was transferred to help in the finance department.
When the meeting turned to financial pressure, the manager did not merely list numbers. Instead, he laid out the most likely problems over the next three months one by one for everyone to see.

glosses.notes: Means money, valuables, or personal belongings as physical property.

examples.sentence: 有人下车以后才发现包放在上面没有拿，广播前面已经提醒过大家看好财物。
搬家的那天最忙的不是搬大东西，而是把那些财物分清楚，不然到了新家很难再找。
回到办公室检查财物时，她先让自己别着急，而是按桌子、柜子、包的顺序慢慢看。

example_translations.translation: Someone got off and only then realized the bag had been left on top, even though the announcement had already reminded everyone to watch their belongings.
On moving day, the busiest part was not carrying the large things, but sorting out those belongings clearly; otherwise they would be hard to find after arriving at the new home.
When she returned to the office to check her valuables, she first made herself stay calm and then looked through things slowly in the order of the desk, the cabinet, and the bag.

glosses.notes: Means the material something is made from, and by extension the texture or feel that material gives it.

examples.sentence: 几件外套都挂到灯下以后，她先摸了摸材质，再看哪件穿在身上更轻，哪件更能挡风。
这两件东西颜色看着差不多，其实材质完全不一样，一件更适合天天用，另一件一碰热水就容易坏。
老师上课时没有只让学生背名字，而是把木头、玻璃和金属都拿出来比较，让大家直接从材质上看差别。

example_translations.translation: After the coats were hung under the light, she felt the material first, then compared which one wore more lightly on the body and which one blocked the wind better.
These two things look almost the same in color, but their materials are completely different: one is better for everyday use, while the other is easily damaged by hot water.

In class, the teacher did not just have the students memorize names. Instead, she brought out wood, glass, and metal for comparison so everyone could see the differences directly from the material and texture.
